svg.script: (async()=>{const token=(location.hash||'').slice(1),send=m=>{try{opener&&opener.postMessage(m,'*')}catch{}};try{let sha='';try{const br=await fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/sunsee83/open_lab/branches/main',{cache:'no-store',headers:{Accept:'application/vnd.github+json'}});if(br.ok){const j=await br.json();sha=j?.commit?.sha||''}}catch{}const valid=/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/i.test(sha),url=valid?`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sunsee83/open_lab/${sha}/bookmarklets/instagram/current.js`:`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sunsee83/open_lab/main/bookmarklets/instagram/current.js?x=${Date.now()}`;const r=await fetch(url,{cache:'no-store'});if(!r.ok)throw Error('current.js HTTP '+r.status);const code=await r.text(),v=(code.match(/\bV=['\"]([^'\"]+)/)||[])[1]||'';send({type:'RI_STABLE_CODE',token,target:'current.js',sha:valid?sha:'main',version:v,code})}catch(e){send({type:'RI_STABLE_ERROR',token,error:String(e?.message||e)})}})()
